chain.label: Off-day call-in to a shift ~6 hours earlier than normal, with no maintenance duty-time limits
chain.trigger: both the mechanic and the inspector were contacted to report to work on an off-duty day (December 6)... their work shift began about 6 hours earlier than their regularly scheduled shifts

chain.label: Mechanic and QC inspector fatigued during the December 6 maintenance shift
chain.trigger: Both the mechanic and the quality control inspector... were likely fatigued during the December 6 shift

caused_by.evidence: because both the mechanic and the inspector had insufficient time to adjust to working an earlier shift than normal, they were experiencing fatigue during the December 6 shift

chain.label: Maintenance documentation lacked delineated task and inspection steps (no work cards)
chain.trigger: the maintenance documentation did not clearly delineate specific inspection steps, which can allow these tasks to be more vulnerable to error

chain.label: Sundance mechanics reused self-locking nuts contrary to Eurocopter and FAA reuse guidance
chain.trigger: Sundance Helicopters was not following Eurocopter and FAA self-locking nut reuse guidance, which led to the repeated improper reuse of degraded nuts on its helicopters

chain.label: Degraded self-locking nut with little or no locking ability securing the fore/aft servo input rod
chain.trigger: The nut became loose (likely because it was degraded)

caused_by.evidence: About half of the self-locking nuts from the 13 helicopters examined... were determined to have no locking capability

chain.label: Mechanic installed the split pin improperly or omitted it during fore/aft servo replacement
chain.trigger: the improper or lack of installation of a split pin

caused_by.evidence: Contributing to the improper or lack of installation of the split pin was the mechanic's fatigue
and the lack of clearly delineated maintenance task steps to follow

chain.label: QC inspector's postmaintenance inspection failed to detect the missing/improper split pin

caused_by.evidence: Contributing to the inadequate postmaintenance inspection was the inspector's fatigue
and the lack of clearly delineated inspection steps to follow

chain.label: Check pilot's before-first-flight external check did not note the discrepancy at the servo connection
chain.trigger: the split pin either was installed improperly or not present, and the check pilot did not note any discrepancy in this area

caused_by.evidence: the mechanic, inspector, and check pilot each had at least one opportunity to observe the fore/aft servo self-locking nut and split pin; however, they did not note that the split pin was installed improperly or not present

chain.label: Nut unthreaded and separated from the bolt under normal in-flight vibration, allowing the bolt to work out of the joint
chain.trigger: In the high-vibration environment of helicopter operation, a degraded self-locking nut could become loose and unthread by vibration until it falls off the bolt

caused_by.evidence: a self-locking nut that was either degraded or not torqued was used when the fore/aft servo was replaced. This allowed the nut to unthread and separate from the bolt
If the split pin was installed improperly or not at all, no backup mechanism for a self-locking nut with degraded locking ability was in place

chain.label: Fore/aft main rotor servo control input rod separated from the servo input lever in flight
chain.trigger: the fore/aft servo bolt disengaged in flight, which resulted in the separation of the control input rod to the fore/aft servo's input lever

caused_by.evidence: the bolt disconnected, and the input rod separated from the linkage while the helicopter was in flight

chain.label: Helicopter rendered uncontrollable; unexpected climb, 90-degree left turn, then rapid descent
chain.trigger: the helicopter unexpectedly climbed about 600 feet, turned about 90 degrees to the left, and then descended about 800 feet, entered a left turn, and descended at a rate of at least 2,500 feet per minute

caused_by.evidence: rendering the helicopter uncontrollable... the loss of control of the fore/aft servo would result in a loss of flight control from which a pilot could not recover

chain.label: Helicopter impacted mountainous terrain nose-low and was destroyed by impact and postimpact fire
chain.trigger: crashed in mountainous terrain about 14 miles east of Las Vegas, Nevada... the helicopter was destroyed by impact forces and postimpact fire

caused_by.evidence: descended at a rate of at least 2,500 feet per minute to impact

chain.label: Pilot and four passengers fatally injured
chain.trigger: The pilot and four passengers were killed

caused_by.evidence: The helicopter impacted the terrain in a nose-low attitude... The pilot and four passengers were killed
